description: Meridian message-bus wire protocol: framing constants, JSON-RPC 2.0 envelopes and error codes. Framing is NDJSON — one envelope per UTF-8 line (FR-M3-01, FR-M3-09).

RequestId.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 request id. The extension allocates monotonically increasing integers; strings are accepted for forwards compatibility.

ErrorObject.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 error object. code is one of ErrorCode; data carries structured detail (e.g. expected/actual for PROTOCOL_MISMATCH).

RequestEnvelope.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 request on the wire.

ResponseEnvelope.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 response. Exactly one of result/error is present (asserted by both implementations, not expressible here without oneOf).

NotificationEnvelope.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 notification (no id, no response).
